findings.evidence: The artifact defines an archive action (line 54) that transitions to project-archived state (line 56), which confirms the project is now in archived projects with no further navigation. No unarchive, restore, or edit path is shown anywhere in the artifact
findings.fix: Add an unarchive action reachable from the project-archived state, or reachable from within the archived projects view, so users can restore a misarchived project
findings.location: archive-confirm screen, Archive button; project-archived result state
findings.violation: NNG-H3-UNDO requires reversible actions to show a path back; archiving a project is a reasonable candidate for reversal but none is specified

findings.evidence: The error message reads exactly: 'Import failed. Error code IMP-500. Contact support if this continues.' The raw code 'IMP-500' is shown without explanation of what condition caused the failure
findings.fix: Replace or augment the error code with a plain-language explanation: e.g., 'Import failed: the file could not be read (IMP-500). Check that the file is in CSV format and try again' or identify the specific failure mode
findings.violation: NNG-H9-IDENTIFY requires error text to say in plain language what went wrong and where, specifically enough that the user can tell which action caused it

findings.evidence: The form contains a Save button (line 27) but the artifact defines no next state after submission: no success confirmation, no error state, no loading indicator specified
findings.fix: Add a success confirmation state that users see after clicking Save, showing that the project name was updated, or specify an error state for failed submissions
findings.location: project-settings screen, Save button for project name
findings.violation: NNG-H1 requires that state-changing actions specify visible feedback about outcome; this action's feedback is entirely absent

findings.evidence: The project-settings screen shows 'Vendor Onboarding' (line 26), but when user navigates to invite-member (line 35), the screen shows only 'Email address' input with no reference to which project. The invite-sent confirmation (line 47) also omits the project name
findings.fix: Add a line to both invite-member and invite-sent screens stating which project the invitation is for, e.g., 'Inviting a member to Vendor Onboarding' or similar
findings.violation: NNG-H6-RECALL requires information users need at each step to be present there, not held in memory from earlier screens

findings.evidence: The message suggests 'Contact support if this continues' but the screen (line 61 - 65) provides only a 'Back to your projects' link; no support email, link, or contact method is available
findings.fix: Add a support contact link or email address to the import-status screen, or replace 'Contact support if this continues' with an actionable suggestion such as 'Try uploading again' or 'Check the file format'
findings.violation: NNG-H9-RECOVER requires error states to point to a next step the user can take, with the control or route available where the message appears
